executable_template.applicability_check: Apply when report-only QA reports that the scheduler absolute Python is unavailable and its local bare-python or python3 fallback is missing, older than Python 3.11, or cannot import pytest and apscheduler.
executable_template.patch_strategy: Make the QA prompt probe python3.13 through python for version >=3.11 plus apscheduler, black, isort, and pytest imports, then require the selected interpreter for focused pytest, diff-quality checks, and source governance.
